records.observation: The blue seat is visibly separated above a detached-looking gray slab. Legs and useful end supports are absent, and the two seat-like layers remain apart in both oblique views.

The blue surface forms the seat of a slim bench on two narrow posts with feet. A gray triangular overlay covers part of the seating surface, so visible layering remains, but the bench body, working seat level and supports are plausible.
